user.title: Connect to Docker
user.description: Home Assistant needs access to the Docker engine. Mount `/var/run/docker.sock` into the Home Assistant container, or use a socket proxy (`tcp://host:2375`).

folders.title: App folders
folders.description: Host folders for apps. Existing compose projects suggest these defaults. To install and update apps, mount the apps folder into the Home Assistant container at the same path.

error.cannot_connect: Can't connect to Docker. Check the socket mount or URL.

data_description.untracked_images: Comma separated parts of image names. Services with these images (databases by default) are not updated with their app, unless you track them per app.

user.title: Add app store repository
user.description: Pick a known repository or paste a URL: a GitHub repository or a `.zip` / `.tar.gz` archive.

error.no_apps: No apps found in this repository.
error.unknown_kind: The format can't be detected. Choose it.

apps_root_not_mounted.title: Apps folder is not mounted
apps_root_not_mounted.description: The apps folder `{path}` is not mounted into the Home Assistant container, so apps can be monitored but not installed or updated. Add `{path}:{path}` to the volumes of the Home Assistant container and restart it.

data_root_not_mounted.title: App data folder is not mounted
data_root_not_mounted.description: The app data folder `{path}` is not mounted into the Home Assistant container. Apps can be installed (Docker creates their data folders), but Home Assistant can't delete their data when they are removed. Add `{path}:{path}` to the volumes of the Home Assistant container and restart it.

update_on_hold.title: Update of {app} is on hold
update_on_hold.description:
{reason}

Back up the database (for example with a dump), upgrade the database service with the `docker_apps.update_services` action or by hand, check that the app works, and the app update is offered again.

supervised.title: Docker Apps on Home Assistant Supervised
supervised.description: The Supervisor marks a system as unsupported when it runs containers it doesn't manage. Docker Apps is made for Home Assistant Container installs.

logs.name: Logs
logs.description: Return the recent log lines of an app or a container.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only lines after this Unix timestamp.

manage.name: Manage app
manage.description: Change how an app is managed: update checks, tracked services, tag filters and the app launcher.

managed.name: Managed
managed.description: Check for updates and allow updates.

launcher.name: Show in app launcher
launcher.description: Show the app in the Docker Apps dashboard card.

services.name: Services
services.description: Services to update with the app. Empty: all except untracked images (databases and caches).

include.name: Include tags
include.description: Only consider tags matching this regular expression.

exclude.name: Exclude tags
exclude.description: Ignore tags matching this regular expression.

upstream.name: Upstream compose URL
upstream.description: URL of the compose file of each release, with '{version}' where the version goes. Services the new version needs are then updated with the app.

allow_db_minor.name: Allow database minor updates
allow_db_minor.description: Update database images within the same major version when a new app version needs it.

update_services.name: Update services
update_services.description: Update single services of an app, also untracked ones, to their newest tag or to a given tag.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Tag to use. Empty: the newest tag of the same kind.

recreate.name: Recreate app
recreate.description: Bring the app up again from its compose files.

pull.name: Pull
pull.description: Pull images first; only changed containers are recreated.

set_environment.name: Set environment variables
set_environment.description: Change environment variables of an app service, such as a password. They are kept in compose.override.yaml, and the app is recreated.

service.name: Service
service.description: Service name in the compose file.

variables.name: Variables
variables.description: Variables to set, for example PASSWORD: my-secret.

set_volumes.name: Set folders and volumes
set_volumes.description: Set all folders and volumes mounted into an app service. Changes are kept in compose.override.yaml, and the app is recreated.

service.name: Service
service.description: Service name in the compose file.

volumes.name: Volumes
volumes.description: List of mounts: source (a folder on the host or a Docker volume name), target (the path in the app) and read_only.

check_updates.name: Check for updates
check_updates.description: Check managed apps for updates now.

repositories.name: Refresh repositories
repositories.description: Download the app store repositories again.

install.name: Install app
install.description: Install an app from an app store repository.

name.name: Name
name.description: Project name. Default: the app name.

uninstall.name: Uninstall app
uninstall.description: Stop and remove the containers and networks of an app.

remove_data.name: Remove data
remove_data.description: Also delete the app and data folders (store apps only).
